people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.
translations.bsb: I declare to you today that you will surely perish; you shall not prolong your days in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.
translations.kjv: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess
translations.asv: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish; ye shall not prolong your days in the land, whither thou passest over the Jordan to go in to possess it.
